AdminControlAction.description: Coarse outcome of an admin control verb (tenant/namespace suspend/resume/update).

oneOf.description: Subject job's public ref, or null when job-less or purged.

resolvedAtUtc.description: When the alert resolved, or null while open.

retryAfterUtc.description: Earliest next delivery attempt, or null.

acknowledgedAtUtc.description: When the alert was acknowledged, or null while open.

AlertListItem.description:
One alert row in a ValueTask<PagedResult<AlertListItem>> IAlerts.ListAsync(ListAlertsQuery query, CancellationToken ct = default(CancellationToken)) page. Channel configuration,
endpoints, and deduplication keys are delivery internals and are never exposed by list reads. JSON
serialization carries the public job ref and hides the numeric job id; the ref goes null once
the subject job row is purged (alerts outlive their job).

ControlAction.description: Coarse outcome of an IJobs control verb.

DeadlineBehaviorCode.description: How the engine treats a job that has passed its deadline.

EventCode.description:
Stable family-local event identifiers. Nearby values improve catalog readability but carry no
runtime subject, subgroup, or outcome semantics. Match events by enum member or textual code.

jobName.description: Subject job's definition name resolved from the catalog (survives the purge), or null.

oneOf.description: Subject job's public ref, or null for namespace-level events; denormalized on the event row, so it survives the job's purge.
Lineage root's public ref, or null when there is no lineage or the root row was purged.

tenantId.description: Tenant id for job-scoped events, or null.

executionNumber.description: Attempt the event belongs to, or null.

oneOf.description: Status before the transition, or null.
Status after the transition, or null.
Execution outcome attached to the event, or null.
Reason recorded with the event, or null.

detailText.description: Free-form (text) or structured (json) detail decoded to text, or null when the event carries no detail or a non-text format.

EventListItem.description:
One audit event row in a ValueTask<PagedResult<EventListItem>> ILedger.ListEventsAsync(ListEventsQuery query, CancellationToken ct = default(CancellationToken)) page. JSON serialization
carries the public job refs and hides the numeric job ids; events outlive their job, and each
ref parameter documents whether it survives the purge.

JobCheckpointKindCode.description:
Discriminator for `JobCheckpoint` rows: which durable substrate feature owns the
`(job_id, kind_code, name)` slot. One physical table carries every simple job-internal
durable slot; the kind keeps the name spaces structurally separate (a user variable can never
collide with a signal or a child latch of the same name).

JobDefinitionDetail.description:
The full job definition row returned by ValueTask<JobDefinitionDetail?> IDefinitions.GetAsync(int jobDefinitionId, CancellationToken ct = default(CancellationToken)): the whole
`definitions` row in its authoritative column order - identity + control, contract + formats,
every policy triple (code `default`, operator `override` [null = inherit], DB-computed
`effective`), and audit bookkeeping. Backs the dashboard's definition detail editor, where
operators see and edit defaults vs overrides vs effective. The grid uses the slimmer
JobDefinitionListItem.

JobDefinitionListItem.description:
One job definition row in a ValueTask<PagedResult<JobDefinitionListItem>> IDefinitions.ListAsync(ListDefinitionsQuery query, CancellationToken ct = default(CancellationToken)) page, trimmed to what
the dashboard definitions grid renders: identity, status, contract type names, and the two policy
columns it surfaces (priority and max attempts, each as effective + override so the grid can flag an
operator override). The full row - every policy triple, formats, audit bookkeeping - is read on
demand via ValueTask<JobDefinitionDetail?> IDefinitions.GetAsync(int jobDefinitionId, CancellationToken ct = default(CancellationToken)) (JobDefinitionDetail).

JobDetail.description:
Read projection of a Job row exposed by `IJobs.GetAsync`: identity, linkage, status,
scheduling, leasing, retention, and input format. The input payload itself is never returned.
Property order mirrors the `jobs` entity (identity, scope/routing, caller keys, input) and
then its 1:1 `runtimes` row, so the shape reads in the same order as the schema; a column
resolved to a public value follows the id it came from, and the created/modified pair closes the
record together. JSON serialization carries the public refs and hides the numeric ids.

JobEnqueueAction.description: Coarse outcome classifier for one enqueued row.

JobExplainAction.description:
A suggested operator move. string JobExplainAction.Kind is a stable slug
(`raise-signal` | `cancel` | `resume` | `restart` | `inspect-timeline` |
`wait-recovery` | `view-result` | `none`); string JobExplainAction.Description is the prose shown to the operator.

JobExplainLease.description:
The execution lease on a Dispatched / Executing Job and the liveness of the worker that holds it.
When bool JobExplainLease.Expired is true the lease has lapsed and `sys.recovery` reclaims the Job on
its next maintenance tick; string JobExplainLease.RecoveryExpectation states that in prose.
string? JobExplainLease.WorkerName is the worker's deployment version; bool JobExplainLease.WorkerStale is true once
the worker has missed heartbeats past `JobsOptions.WorkerDeadAfter`.

JobExplainStep.description: One step slot's state, with string JobExplainStep.Explanation rendering it as a plain-English clause.

JobExplainWait.description: The durable wait a Suspended Job is blocked on: a signal name, or a timer slot and its due instant.

JobExplanation.description:
Plain-English explanation of a Job's current durable state: where the work is, why it moved there,
and what an operator can do next. Assembled from the same `runtimes` / `workers` /
`steps` / `checkpoints` / `events` rows an operator could read with a `SELECT`:
Acta explains the work it runs rather than hiding it behind synthesized state. Returned by
ValueTask<JobExplanation?> IJobs.ExplainAsync(JobLookup job, CancellationToken ct = default(CancellationToken)); the CLI renders it as prose, the dashboard as a panel.
StatusMeaning is the [Code] description of Status; Headline is a
one-sentence summary; ActiveWait / Lease are set only in the relevant states;
LastExecutedBy names the worker that last ran the job (for states with no live lease);
Reason is the most recent reason on the timeline; NextActions are the operator's
moves, most relevant first.

JobLineageChild.description: A direct child of the focused Job, linkable to its own detail view.

JobLineageJob.description:
A Job node in the lineage map - the focused Job or one of its ancestors. Carries the public
JobRef JobLineageJob.JobRef forms alongside the JSON-hidden numeric ids, matching JobListItem.

JobLineageMap.description:
A compact runtime truth map for one focused Job: the ancestor context up to the lineage root, the
focused Job itself with its steps and the durable wait it is blocked on, and its direct children.
Like JobExplanation it is assembled from the same durable rows an operator could read
with a `SELECT` - Acta maps the work it runs rather than hiding it behind synthesized state.
Returned by ValueTask<JobLineageMap?> IJobs.GetLineageMapAsync(JobLookup job, JobLineageMapOptions? options = null, CancellationToken ct = default(CancellationToken)); the dashboard renders it as a lineage panel.
V1 is shallow: Ancestors is context only (root first, immediate parent last, no steps
of their own), Job is the focused subtree root, and Children are the direct children
capped at int JobLineageMapOptions.ChildLimit with ChildrenHasMore flagging a
truncated set. Recursive descent below direct children is deferred.

tenantKey.description: Tenant's caller-supplied key resolved from the catalog, or null.

oneOf.description: Parent job's public ref, or null for roots.
Lineage root's public ref, or null.

correlationKey.description: Caller-supplied correlation id (trace / request / order id), or null.

failureCount.description: Consecutive-failure count behind the retry budget.

JobListItem.description:
One job row in a ValueTask<PagedResult<JobListItem>> ILedger.ListJobsAsync(ListJobsQuery query, CancellationToken ct = default(CancellationToken)) page. Carries identity, lifecycle, and
audit-facing fields only; the input payload is never exposed by list reads. JSON serialization
carries the public refs and hides the numeric ids.

JobPriorityCode.description:
Claim-priority value for `JobRuntime.Priority`. Discrete five-tier code-system enum
(`Bulk` / `Normal` / `High` / `Critical` / `Realtime`); no intermediate
values. Strict priority ordering on claim (no aging, no anti-starvation budget), so operators
isolate bulk workloads in their own `JobNamespace`. Set by the definition policy, definition
override, or per-enqueue priority override.

JobRef.description:
Public stable reference for one Job row: "job_" plus 26 lowercase Crockford Base32 characters
encoding the canonical big-endian UUID bytes. Dashboards, HTTP APIs, and clients address jobs
by this value; the numeric JobId stays the internal engine identity. Parsing is
case-insensitive; emission is always canonical lowercase.

JobStepStatusCode.description:
State machine for `JobStep` rows. INSERT-once on first invocation (`Pending`);
UPDATE-in-place across retries; terminal transition to `Succeeded` (with `Result` populated),
`Exhausted` (parent receives `StepExhaustedException`), or `Interrupted` (an
`AtMostOnce` step re-entered before completion; parent receives `StepInterruptedException`). One row per
`(JobId, Name)`; the framework never INSERTs a second step row for the same slot.

id.description: DB-assigned namespace id, referenced by `job.namespace_id`. The seeded sys namespace is id 1.

status.description: Namespace lifecycle status (Active resolves at enqueue; Suspended rejects it).

ownerTeam.description: Owning-team identifier surfaced on dashboards, or null.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency row version; pass as the expected version to a CAS control verb.

NamespaceListItem.description:
One namespace row in an ValueTask<PagedResult<NamespaceListItem>> INamespaces.ListAsync(ListNamespacesQuery query, CancellationToken ct = default(CancellationToken)) page, projected from the
`namespaces` table, and the one representation `GET /namespaces` answers with.
ValueTask<PagedResult<string>> INamespaces.ListNamesAsync(ListNamespacesQuery query, CancellationToken ct = default(CancellationToken)) remains for callers that want only the names.

NamespaceStatusCode.description:
Namespace state machine. 10-spaced ids; live states 10..80, mirroring
TenantStatusCode. Id 90 is reserved for an Archived (hidden/historical)
status, for symmetry with TenantStatusCode's reservation.

oldestReadyAgeSeconds.description: Seconds the oldest due Ready job has been claimable; null when none are due.

staleWorkerCount.description: Active or Draining workers not seen within the stale threshold.

dueSoonScheduleCount.description: Live schedules due inside the due-soon window.

jobCount.description: All jobs in scope, including system jobs.

systemJobCount.description: System jobs in scope (reserved `sys.`-prefixed names); JobCount minus this is the user total.

executorCapacity.description: Executor slots across live workers (Active or Draining, seen inside the stale threshold); what ExecutingCount saturates against.

scheduleLagSeconds.description: Seconds the most overdue live schedule is past its next run; null when none are overdue.

OverviewSnapshot.description: One-shot health counters for the dashboard overview, computed on the database clock.

ScheduleListItem.description:
One schedule row in a ValueTask<PagedResult<ScheduleListItem>> ISchedules.ListAsync(ListSchedulesQuery query, CancellationToken ct = default(CancellationToken)) page. Expression and
time zone are the effective values: the operator override when present, else the original.

SchedulePreview.description:
A read-only forecast of a schedule's upcoming fire instants, computed live (no persisted state is
read or written). string SchedulePreview.Expression and string SchedulePreview.TimeZoneId are the effective values
(operator override when present, else the original); IReadOnlyList<DateTime> SchedulePreview.NextRunsUtc is strictly
increasing and may be shorter than requested when the expression is exhausted.

the `tenants` table. The string TenantListItem.TenantKey is the caller-supplied opaque external
identifier; the human label lives in string? TenantListItem.Description.

Tenant state machine. 10-spaced ids; live states 10..80. Id 90 is reserved for an
Archived (hidden/historical) status, to be added when the dashboard/API need historical tenant
cleanup.
